newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Discount Auto said cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Discount Auto said cut.

text.p: -- Dean Witter downgraded Discount Auto Parts Inc to neutral from buy, according to a Dean Witter source.
-- the opening of trade was delayed due to imbalance, according to the New York Stock Exchange. The last sale was 24-1/4, the indication $20-$23.
-- company said Wednesday that earnings for at least the third and fourth quarters of this year could be be hurt because it expects lower commercial sales of its R-12 freon.
